commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a fragile 28 and the scanner gate signaling WEAK, Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil enforce strict capital preservation. In an environment where the general market corrects under elevated crude and yields, three out of four stocks succumb to downward drag. Failed breakouts multiply in adverse tape conditions. Jesse Livermore taught that sitting tight in cash is an active trading decision. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate that new buys be severely restricted to confirmed Stage 2 leaders displaying accelerating earnings and pristine VCP pivots, while keeping position sizes modest and cutting losses ruthlessly at predetermined stop triggers.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box

ACE.technical: Forming an orderly double bottom with a cup depth of 12.8% and a tight 5.6% handle in the upper half. Price holds firmly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, meeting Minervini Trend Template standards. Volume dry-up in the handle demonstrates constructive VCP characteristics ahead of the 1,269.27 neckline pivot.
ACE.fundamental: Commands over 60% domestic market share in mobile and tower cranes. Q1 FY27 operating profit margin expanded to 14.9% with ROCE above 32% and negligible debt (D/E 0.01). However, sub-25% EPS growth in recent quarters keeps CANSLIM fundamental qualification partial.
ACE.risk: Thesis invalidates if price breaks 1,188.57 handle support; cut losses immediately to honor strict SEPA risk control.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: While trading above major moving averages, the stock poked above the 321.27 pivot and immediately closed back below it. This failed breakout constitutes Jesse Livermore's classic danger signal, indicating lack of follow-through demand despite a multi-month double-bottom structure.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Operates high-margin terminal infrastructure (EBITDA margin ~76.7%), but Q1 FY27 net profit contracted 7.0% YoY due to geopolitical disruptions weighing on gas segment throughput. Sub-par ROCE of 7.6% and a lofty P/E of 120 fail CANSLIM's C+A growth acceleration tests.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Livermore pivot failure combined with negative earnings trend; breakdown below 290.68 confirms distribution and requires full exit.

AETHER.technical: Classic Stage 2 advance trading firmly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Fulfills Minervini's Trend Template, carving out a double-bottom base with neckline resistance at 1,799.80. RSI at 64 and positive MACD confirm underlying accumulation and dominant relative strength against a weak benchmark.
AETHER.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals: Q1 FY27 net profit surged 33.5% YoY on 27.3% sales growth, driven by a 31% operating margin. Long-term contract manufacturing partnerships with Dow Chemical and Baker Hughes provide strong revenue predictability alongside a nearly unleveraged balance sheet.
AETHER.risk: Setup invalidates if the base breaks below 1,670.91 pivot support; execute stop immediately to guard against broader market contagion.

AHCL.technical: Powerful Stage 2 momentum breakout, clearing 20-session resistance and striking a new 52-week high. Moving averages are stacked favorably (price > EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200) with MACD above zero, confirming strong Darvas-box breakout characteristics and top-tier relative strength.
AHCL.fundamental: Exceptional top-line hyper-growth (+163% YoY) driven by API capacity expansions and acquisitions. Net profit expanded 87.6% YoY with ROCE at 20.8% and ROE at 18.4%. Raw material cost pressures on margins are expected to normalize as new capacities commercialize.
AHCL.risk: A breakdown below 29.38 invalidates the 20-day breakout; trigger stop discipline to eliminate capital erosion.

AONELIQUID.technical: Consolidates in a hairline range along moving averages. However, because this is an exchange-traded debt instrument tracking overnight repo rates rather than an operating corporate entity, standard Darvas box breakouts and SEPA momentum rules are functionally inapplicable.
AONELIQUID.risk: Cash equivalent instrument tracking overnight tri-party repo yields; incapable of generating equity capital gains or CANSLIM alpha.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Constructive double-bottom continuation structure sustaining above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. RSI at 65 indicates strong underlying momentum without overbought exhaustion. The 953.70 neckline provides a well-defined pivot point under Minervini and Darvas breakout criteria.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Dramatically improved Q1 FY27 performance with net profit up 151.2% YoY and revenue up 111.2%. Operating margins expanded to 41% with ROCE of 29.6% and negligible leverage. However, a negative Q4 FY26 restricts qualification to partial pending another 25%+ quarter.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Pattern thesis fails on a breach below the 856.75 swing low; exit without hesitation to enforce stop discipline.
